title: Contact Us
seo_title: Contact Us | Grow Green Weed Control – Lawn Treatment Experts in Louisiana
seo_desc: Get in touch with Grow Green Weed Control for expert lawn fertilization, weed control, and pest treatment services across South Louisiana. Call or message us today!
headings: Real help from a local team.
Reach the right people—without a call center.
paragraphs: Whether you have a service question, need account help, or want us to look at a lawn concern, you’ll hear from people who know South Louisiana lawns.
Give us a few details and the right person on our team will follow up. Current customers: including your service address in the message helps us locate your account faster.
Your information is used only to respond to your request.
Thanks for reaching out. The Grow Green team will review your message and follow up as soon as possible during business hours.
Our office team works directly with Grow Green technicians and customer accounts throughout the Greater Baton Rouge area.

Grow Green is locally owned. That means your message reaches a nearby team that understands the lawns, weather, weeds, and expectations of South Louisiana homeowners.

Messages received during office hours are typically answered the same business day. Messages sent after 4:00 p.m., on weekends, or on holidays are answered the next business day.
You can, but our dedicated quote form is faster because it collects your property address and the exact services you are interested in. Use the “Get My Free Quote” button for the best experience.

We serve Greater Baton Rouge and nearby Ascension and Livingston Parish communities, including Prairieville, Gonzales, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary, and surrounding areas.

Before you send your message.

A few quick answers can help you choose the fastest way to reach us.

How quickly will someone respond?

Messages received during office hours are typically answered the same business day. Messages sent after 4:00 p.m., on weekends, or on holidays are answered the next business day.

Should I use this form to request pricing?

You can, but our dedicated quote form is faster because it collects your property address and the exact services you are interested in. Use the “Get My Free Quote” button for the best experience.

What should current customers include?

Please include the service address and a clear description of your question or concern. Photos can be shared when our office team follows up with you.

What areas does Grow Green serve?

We serve Greater Baton Rouge and nearby Ascension and Livingston Parish communities, including Prairieville, Gonzales, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary, and surrounding areas.
